items: Smooth Performance - This tablet delivers smooth multitasking and app performance with an efficient Unisoc T310 processor and 16GB (4+12) of RAM. It is equipped with a 6600mAh battery that supports up to 6 hours of continuous video playback

HD IPS Display - This tablet features a vibrant 10.1-inch HD screen with 1280×800 resolution and rich color reproduction. It includes an eye protection mode that reduces blue light through adjustable color temperature, ideal for long reading or viewing sessions

Fast Connection - The tablet supports reliable dual-band Wi-Fi on both 2.4GHz and 5GHz bands for stable streaming and browsing, plus Bluetooth 5.0 for wireless accessories. It offers 128GB of built-in storage and supports TF card expansion up to 1TB.

Modern System - This tablet runs Android 15 and is certified for GMS, enabling access to the Google Play Store for apps and the latest security updates. It also features multitasking tools like split-screen mode.

Worry-Free Shopping - This tablet includes a 1-year warranty covering defects in materials and workmanship under normal use. The package contains the tablet, a charger, a USB-C cable, and a quick start guide.
